text:
deploy-bot: Deployment finished — release 2026.3.9 pushed to prod at 2026-03-17T20:15Z. Deployer: @michelle. Targets: inference-api, router, kv-cache. Canary at 10% for 20m.

michelle: Canary rolled to 10% at ~20:16Z, then to 100% at ~20:18Z. Running quick smoke now. Will post checklist below.

michelle: Smoke checks:
- /health => 200 OK
- basic generation (sanity prompt) => OK, sample looks correct
- embeddings pipeline => OK
- metrics check: small p95 bump on /v1/generate (140ms -> ~190ms) noticed in first 5m
@praveen can you prewarm model workers in us-west1 if this persists?

john: seeing the same p95 bump in traces. Traces point to slightly longer model load on cold paths in us-west1. Quick command I ran: 
```
kubectl -n prod logs deploy/inference-api | grep 'kv-cache-miss' | tail -n 20
```
I also increased readiness probe timeout on the canary to 30s.

sanjay: if p95 stays high i'll scale the worker pool preemptively. Proposal: autoscaler min=3 -> min=6 for 30m window. I'll only do it with a thumbs-up.

olivia: pushed a tiny connection-pool tweak (PR #2142) that should reduce contention on heavy bursts. If everyone agrees i can cut a canary redeploy.

praveen: restarted model-worker pool in us-west1 to prewarm. Command used: 
```
gcloud compute instances restart model-worker-*-us-west1 --zone=us-west1-a
```
Restart completed ~20:25Z. Quick synthetic run (50 sequential requests) shows p95 ~155ms now. :tada:

qa-bot: Smoke test results: smoke/basic ✅, smoke/embeddings ✅, smoke/auth ✅. Full regression suite queued (id: rq-2145679).

michelle: Great — p95 back down after prewarm + tiny fix. No rollback required. Conditions: keep monitoring for 30m; if p95 > 220ms for >5m escalate to oncall. I'll post a final status update at +30m. :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

john: noted. Throwing a short watchlist on dashboard (inference-api -> latency p95) and alert rule extended to 5m.

sanjay: scaling action ready to roll back if we see degradation.

michelle: Closing thread for now, will update if anything changes. Thanks all — especially @praveen and @olivia for the quick responses. :thumbsup:
